title: Celerik UI theme
description: Design tokens of a Celerik theme. Theme::toCss() (PHP), the ThemeBuilder and bin/celerik-theme turn it into a stylesheet loaded after the base theme.

base.description: The look the theme starts from: celerik.css alone (bootstrap), or with celerik-material.css or celerik-tailwind.css.

radius.description: Corner radius of fields, cards, the grid and the calendar, in rem.

fontFamily.description: A CSS font stack of family names and generic families. Omit it to keep the base theme's font.

shadow.description: How containers (grid, chart, calendar, file manager) stand out from the page.

palette.description: Colors of one mode (data-bs-theme="light" or "dark"). Text pairs need 4.5:1, field borders 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.3, 1.4.11).

primary.description: Buttons, links, active tabs, the current page, calendar events.

primaryHover.description: Hovered and pressed buttons, hovered links.

onPrimary.description: Text and icons on the primary color.

muted.description: Secondary text: help texts, captions, placeholders.

surface.description: Raised areas: grid header, upload area, toolbars.

inputBorder.description: Borders of form fields, which identify them (3:1).
